evidence.quote: Amazon CloudFront now supports SHA-256 as a hash algorithm for creating signed URLs and signed cookies.
Previously, CloudFront signed URLs and signed cookies used SHA-1 exclusively for signature generation.
Existing signed URLs and signed cookies that don't specify a hash algorithm continue to use SHA-1, so this change is fully backwards compatible.

evidence.heading: Amazon CloudFront now supports SHA-256 for signed URLs and signed cookies

evidence.quote: To use SHA-256, include the Hash-Algorithm=SHA256 query parameter in your signed URLs, or the CloudFront-Hash-Algorithm=SHA256 cookie attribute for signed cookies.
